sampling: Original 1000 records retained unchanged; append first eligible new PMIDs in current PubMed pub-date order under the same query/cutoff. Not a random sample.
content: Only PubMed Article/Abstract/AbstractText body; labels, titles and full text are excluded from analysis.
publication_date_note: PubMed DP searches electronic and print dates. Two selected articles have Journal PubDate year 2027 and Electronic ArticleDate in 2026, within query cutoff. Document.year preserves the journal issue year.
copyright_notice: PubMed abstracts may be protected by copyright. Retained locally for course analysis; no blanket open-license claim.
